text:
Gartner is dumb.  Just running each browser anonymously in its own sandbox will solve the problem.

Gartner doesn't even understand the root cause of the problem.  People use agentic browsers because the website is poorly designed and AI unfriendly  

Why would anyone want to use the slow agentic browser if you can simply call an API.

reshared_post.author_headline: 🚀 CEO & Founder, ID Privacy AI | 🧠 Building the Agentic Infrastructure Layer for Automotive & Regulated Enterprises | 🎙️ Voice-First AI That Executes Revenue Workflows | 🏭 Multi-OEM Certified & 3500% Growth YoY 🚀
reshared_post.reshared_text:
🚨 Gartner just dropped a bomb: “Block all AI browsers for the foreseeable future.” NOW 😳‼️

Let that sink in for a second. 🤯

🌎 The world’s leading research firm is telling enterprises to hit the brakes on #AI browsers like #ChatGPT Atlas and #Perplexity Comet.

Why? Because default AI browser settings prioritize convenience over security and sensitive data is being shipped to cloud backends with reckless abandon. 🔐

Here’s what’s keeping #CISO leaders up at night:
	• Browsing history, credentials, and financial data exposed to prompt injection attacks
	• 27.7% of organizations already have employees using Atlas & many without IT’s knowledge 😬
	• Sensitive data loss to AI services that’s irreversible and untraceable

But here’s where it gets interesting. 📊

🚀 The AI agent market is EXPLODING 🎉 $7.63B in 2025, projected to hit $182.97B by 2033 (49.6% CAGR).
Companies report 61% boosts in employee efficiency, and 90% say AI agents improve workflows 🙌

So what gives?

The answer is simple: Architecture matters.
Privacy can’t be an afterthought. The way AI is built matters more than the tool itself.

At ID Privacy AI, this is exactly why we build voice-first conversational AI agents with a fundamentally different philosophy.

We focus on:
✅ Controlled orchestration - private workflows, secure tool calling, isolated knowledge bases 🔐
✅ Transparent data handling - you know what’s processed and why
✅ Security by design - not bolted on later
✅ Voice-first interaction - natural conversations that can be secured, even with confidential PII
✅ Tokenized payments - PCI-safe workflows where the AI never sees or stores raw card data 💳🛡️

🤖 The AGENTIC truth? The AI agent revolution is inevitable but it doesn’t have to be a privacy nightmare.

The future isn’t AI doing everything, everywhere, all at once.

It’s AI doing the RIGHT things, the RIGHT way, with transparency and control. 🙌

Voice-first agents offer a middle path: powerful automation that keeps humans in the loop while respecting personal data. 🧑‍💻🎙️

With global security spend projected to hit $212B in 2025 (up 15.1% YoY), organizations are waking up to reality:
AI convenience without security just multiplies risk. 🚨

My question to you:
Are you adding AI solutions that solve problems or creating new ones? 💭

The Gartner warning isn’t a death blow for AI agents.
It’s a PRIVACY wake-up call.

What’s your take? Are AI browsers a risk inside your organization? 👇
